fields.Name: R2-real -> S4.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.28 (phase 2, dataset R2-real, criterion S4.4): on R2-real a request that ranks a non-negative (Tweedie, power 1.5) target's candidates by RMSE is refused with HTTP 400 before anything is fitted, 1 of 1. It fails when the cross-family RMSE refusal is removed (the request is accepted).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Ranking a non-negative target's candidates by RMSE is refused with HTTP 400, 1 of 1 (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
